timeout_attribution.confirmed: First rejection breakpoint triggered after 2 s barometer fusion age; therefore that breakpoint halt cannot cause its own trigger. No active-flight halt preceded first hit in the captured diagnostic sequence.
timeout_attribution.source_path: INS propagation and Estimator prediction processing accept only FLIGHT/RECOVERY; after LANDED, those fusion updates stop while mission_running flag remains set.
timeout_attribution.bounded_inference: The post-stop 2 s health age is consistent with stopped fusion. This is not proof of a barometer device failure or accurate hardware time under every debug condition.
